scenario.title: Library Management System
scenario.description:
A registered library member logs into the library system, searches for a book, checks its availability, borrows the book, and verifies the borrowing details.

Features to test
Feature	What to verify
Login	Valid/invalid login, mandatory fields
Book Search	Search by title, author, ISBN, no-result search
Book Details	Title, author, availability, number of copies
Borrow Book	Borrow available book, borrowing limit
Borrow Confirmation	Due date, borrowed book details, confirmation
Return Book	Return borrowed book, status update

reference_cases.title: Successful login with valid credentials
reference_cases.preconditions: User has a registered account with username 'testuser' and password 'Test@123'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to library login page
2. Enter username 'testuser'
3. Enter password 'Test@123'
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: User is logged in successfully and redirected to the home/dashboard page. Username is displayed in the header.

reference_cases.title: Login fails with incorrect password
reference_cases.preconditions: User has a registered account with username 'testuser'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to library login page
2. Enter valid username 'testuser'
3. Enter incorrect password 'wrongpass'
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: Login fails with error message 'Invalid username or password' displayed. User remains on login page.

reference_cases.title: Login with empty username field
reference_cases.preconditions: None
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to library login page
2. Leave username field empty
3. Enter password 'Test@123'
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message appears indicating username is required. Login does not proceed.

reference_cases.title: Login with empty password field
reference_cases.preconditions: None
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to library login page
2. Enter username 'testuser'
3. Leave password field empty
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message appears indicating password is required. Login does not proceed.

reference_cases.title: Search for book by exact title match
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'The Great Gatsby' exists in the library catalog
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter 'The Great Gatsby' in the search box
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: Search results display 'The Great Gatsby' with correct author, ISBN, and availability status

reference_cases.title: Search for book by partial title
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'The Great Gatsby' exists in the library catalog
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter 'Great Gatsby' (without 'The') in search box
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: Search results include 'The Great Gatsby' and any other books with matching keywords

reference_cases.title: Search for book by author name
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Books by 'F. Scott Fitzgerald' exist in catalog
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter 'F. Scott Fitzgerald' in search box
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: All books by F. Scott Fitzgerald are displayed in search results

reference_cases.title: Search for book by ISBN
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book with ISBN '978-0-7432-7356-5' exists
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter ISBN '978-0-7432-7356-5'
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: Exact book matching the ISBN is displayed with all details

reference_cases.title: Search with non-existent book title
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter 'XYZ123NonExistentBook999' in search box
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: No results found message is displayed. No books are shown in results.

reference_cases.title: Search with empty search field
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Leave search box empty
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: Either validation error appears asking to enter search term, or all books are displayed

reference_cases.title: Search with special characters only
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to book search page
2. Enter '@#$%^&*' in search box
3. Click Search button
reference_cases.expected_result: No results found or appropriate error message. System doesn't crash.

reference_cases.title: View book details for available book
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'The Great Gatsby' has 3 copies available
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Click on the book from search results
reference_cases.expected_result: Book details page shows title, author, ISBN, availability status as 'Available', and number of copies (3 available out of total)

reference_cases.title: View book details for unavailable book
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'To Kill a Mockingbird' has 0 copies available (all borrowed)
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'To Kill a Mockingbird'
2. Click on the book from search results
reference_cases.expected_result: Book details page shows title, author, ISBN, availability status as 'Not Available' or 'All copies borrowed', 0 copies available

reference_cases.title: Borrow an available book successfully
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'The Great Gatsby' is available. User has not exceeded borrowing limit
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
4. Confirm borrowing action if prompted
reference_cases.expected_result: Book is borrowed successfully. Confirmation message is displayed. Available copies count decreases by 1.

reference_cases.title: Attempt to borrow book with zero availability
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'To Kill a Mockingbird' has 0 available copies
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'To Kill a Mockingbird'
2. Click on the book
3. Attempt to click 'Borrow' button
reference_cases.expected_result: Borrow button is either disabled/not visible, or clicking it shows error message 'No copies available'

reference_cases.title: Attempt to borrow when at borrowing limit
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has already borrowed maximum allowed books (e.g., 5 books)
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for an available book
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed: 'You have reached your borrowing limit' or similar. Book is not borrowed.

reference_cases.title: Verify borrowing limit boundary - borrow last allowed book
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has borrowed 4 books (limit is 5)
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for an available book
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
reference_cases.expected_result: Book is borrowed successfully. User now has 5 borrowed books (at the limit).

reference_cases.title: View borrowing confirmation details
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for available book 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
4. View confirmation page/message
reference_cases.expected_result: Confirmation displays: book title, author, borrow date (today's date), due date (typically 14-30 days from today), and success message

reference_cases.title: Verify due date calculation is correct
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Borrowing period is 14 days
reference_cases.steps:
1. Note today's date
2. Search for available book
3. Borrow the book
4. Check due date on confirmation
reference_cases.expected_result: Due date is exactly 14 days from today's date (accounting for weekends/holidays per library policy)

reference_cases.title: Verify borrowed book appears in user's borrowed list
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to 'My Books' or 'Borrowed Books' section
2. Note current borrowed books
3. Borrow a new book 'The Great Gatsby'
4. Return to 'My Books' section
reference_cases.expected_result: 'The Great Gatsby' now appears in the borrowed books list with borrow date and due date

reference_cases.title: Return a borrowed book successfully
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has borrowed book 'The Great Gatsby'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to 'My Books' or 'Borrowed Books' section
2. Locate 'The Great Gatsby' in borrowed list
3. Click 'Return' button
4. Confirm return if prompted
reference_cases.expected_result: Book is returned successfully. Confirmation message appears. Book is removed from borrowed list or status changes to 'Returned'.

reference_cases.title: Verify book availability increases after return
reference_cases.preconditions: User has borrowed 'The Great Gatsby'. Before borrowing, it had 3 available copies, now has 2
reference_cases.steps:
1. Return 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Search for 'The Great Gatsby'
3. View book details
reference_cases.expected_result: Available copies count is now 3 (increased by 1 after return)

reference_cases.title: Verify returned book can be borrowed again
reference_cases.preconditions: User has just returned 'The Great Gatsby'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
reference_cases.expected_result: Book can be borrowed again successfully without issues

reference_cases.title: Attempt to borrow the same book twice
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has already borrowed 'The Great Gatsby'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Search for 'The Great Gatsby'
2. Click on the book
3. Click 'Borrow' button
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message: 'You have already borrowed this book' or borrow button is disabled

reference_cases.title: Search with very long string input
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to search page
2. Enter a very long string (500+ characters) in search box
3. Click Search
reference_cases.expected_result: System handles gracefully - either truncates input, shows validation error, or returns no results. No crash or performance issue.

reference_cases.title: Login with SQL injection attempt
reference_cases.preconditions: None
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter username as: admin' OR '1'='1
3. Enter any password
4. Click Login
reference_cases.expected_result: Login fails with invalid credentials error. No SQL injection occurs. User is not logged in.

reference_cases.title: Verify session timeout after inactivity
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Session timeout is set (e.g., 30 minutes)
reference_cases.steps:
1. Log in successfully
2. Remain idle for the timeout period
3. Attempt to perform any action (search, borrow)
reference_cases.expected_result: User is logged out automatically. Redirected to login page with session expired message.

reference_cases.title: Case insensitive book search
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Book 'The Great Gatsby' exists
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to search page
2. Enter 'the great gatsby' (all lowercase)
3. Click Search
reference_cases.expected_result: 'The Great Gatsby' appears in search results. Search is case-insensitive.

unsupported.title: Verify session timeout after inactivity
unsupported.reason: Session timeout - the practice app does not model time passage or automatic logout

helpers.name: setup
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Resets the app to initial state: logs out any user, clears visible message, sets current page to Login, restores all data to starting values (books, borrowings as listed in data section)

helpers.name: teardown
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: If id is provided and is a borrowing id created during test, deletes that borrowing and restores the book's available_copies count. If id is None, does nothing. Does not affect initial borrowings (ids 101-109)

helpers.name: current_page
helpers.returns: String: current page name (Login, Home, Search, Book Details, or My Books)
helpers.behaviour: Returns the name of the page currently displayed

helpers.name: visible_message
helpers.returns: String: the current visible message, or empty string if none
helpers.behaviour: Returns the message currently shown to the user, or empty string if no message is displayed

helpers.name: logged_in_user
helpers.returns: String: display name of logged in user, or empty string if not logged in
helpers.behaviour: Returns the display name shown in header (e.g. 'Test User'), or empty string if no user is logged in

helpers.name: navigate_to_login
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Navigates to Login page, clears any visible message

helpers.name: navigate_to_search
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: If user is logged in, navigates to Search page and clears visible message. If not logged in, sets message 'Please log in first' and stays on current page

helpers.name: navigate_to_my_books
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: If user is logged in, navigates to My Books page and clears visible message. If not logged in, sets message 'Please log in first' and stays on current page

helpers.name: fill_login_form
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Fills the username and password fields on Login page with provided values. Does nothing if not on Login page

helpers.name: click_login
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Submits login form. If username is empty, sets message 'Username is required' and stays on Login page. If password is empty, sets message 'Password is required' and stays on Login page. If credentials are invalid, sets message 'Invalid username or password' and stays on Login page. If valid, logs in user, navigates to Home page, clears message

helpers.name: click_logout
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Logs out current user, navigates to Login page, clears message

helpers.name: fill_search_form
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Fills the search box on Search page with provided query. Does nothing if not on Search page

helpers.name: click_search
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Performs search with current query. If query is empty, displays all books. Searches case-insensitively in title, author, and ISBN fields (partial match for title/author, exact match for ISBN). If no results found, sets message 'No results found'. If results found, clears message and displays results on Search page

helpers.name: search_results
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{id, title, author, isbn, availability}] where availability is 'Available' or 'Not Available'
helpers.behaviour: Returns list of books from last search. Each book object has id (number), title (string), author (string), isbn (string), availability (string: 'Available' if available_copies > 0, else 'Not Available'). Returns empty list if no search performed or no results

helpers.name: click_book
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Navigates to Book Details page for the specified book_id, clears message. If book_id doesn't exist, sets message 'Book not found' and stays on current page

helpers.name: book_details
helpers.returns: Object: {id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies, availability_status} or None if not on Book Details page
helpers.behaviour: Returns details of book currently shown on Book Details page. availability_status is 'Available' if available_copies > 0, else 'Not Available'. Returns None if not on Book Details page

helpers.name: borrow_button_visible
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if Borrow button is visible and enabled, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Returns true if on Book Details page and Borrow button is shown and enabled (book has available copies, user hasn't borrowed this book, user is under borrowing limit). Returns false otherwise

helpers.name: click_borrow
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Attempts to borrow the book shown on Book Details page. If not on Book Details page, does nothing. If book has 0 available copies, sets message 'No copies available' and stays on page. If user already borrowed this book, sets message 'You have already borrowed this book' and stays on page. If user is at borrowing limit (5 books), sets message 'You have reached your borrowing limit' and stays on page. If successful, creates borrowing record with borrow_date=2024-02-10, due_date=2024-02-24 (14 days later), decreases available_copies by 1, sets message 'Book borrowed successfully. Due date: 2024-02-24', stays on Book Details page

helpers.name: borrowed_books_list
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{borrowing_id, book_id, title, author, borrow_date, due_date}]
helpers.behaviour: Returns list of books currently borrowed by logged-in user (status='borrowed'). Returns empty list if not logged in or user has no borrowed books. Only available when on My Books page, returns empty list on other pages

helpers.name: click_return
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Returns the book for specified borrowing_id. If borrowing doesn't exist or doesn't belong to current user, sets message 'Borrowing not found' and stays on page. If successful, changes borrowing status to 'returned', increases book's available_copies by 1, sets message 'Book returned successfully', stays on My Books page

helpers.name: api_login
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, user_id, display_name} or {ok: false, error: 'message'}
helpers.behaviour: Validates credentials. If username is empty, returns {ok: false, error: 'Username is required'}. If password is empty, returns {ok: false, error: 'Password is required'}. If credentials don't match any user, returns {ok: false, error: 'Invalid username or password'}. If valid, logs in user and returns {ok: true, user_id: number, display_name: string}

helpers.name: api_search_books
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, books: [{id, title, author, isbn, available_copies, total_copies}]} or {ok: false, error: 'message'}
helpers.behaviour: Searches books case-insensitively. If query is empty, returns all books. Searches in title (partial match), author (partial match), and isbn (exact match). Returns {ok: true, books: [...]} with matching books. If no matches, returns {ok: true, books: []}. Never returns error

helpers.name: api_get_book
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, book: {id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies}} or {ok: false, error: 'Book not found'}
helpers.behaviour: Returns details for specified book_id. If book doesn't exist, returns {ok: false, error: 'Book not found'}. Otherwise returns {ok: true, book: {...}}

helpers.name: api_borrow_book
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, borrowing_id, due_date} or {ok: false, error: 'message'}
helpers.behaviour: Attempts to borrow book. If book doesn't exist, returns {ok: false, error: 'Book not found'}. If available_copies is 0, returns {ok: false, error: 'No copies available'}. If user already has an active borrowing of this book, returns {ok: false, error: 'You have already borrowed this book'}. If user has 5 active borrowings, returns {ok: false, error: 'You have reached your borrowing limit'}. If successful, creates borrowing with borrow_date=2024-02-10, due_date=2024-02-24, status='borrowed', decreases available_copies by 1, returns {ok: true, borrowing_id: number, due_date: '2024-02-24'}

helpers.name: api_return_book
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true} or {ok: false, error: 'message'}
helpers.behaviour: Returns borrowed book. If borrowing doesn't exist, returns {ok: false, error: 'Borrowing not found'}. If borrowing doesn't belong to user_id, returns {ok: false, error: 'Borrowing not found'}. If borrowing status is already 'returned', returns {ok: false, error: 'Book already returned'}. If successful, sets status to 'returned', increases book's available_copies by 1, returns {ok: true}

helpers.name: api_get_user_borrowings
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, borrowings: [{borrowing_id, book_id, title, author, borrow_date, due_date, status}]}
helpers.behaviour: Returns all borrowings for user_id with status='borrowed'. Includes book title and author. Returns {ok: true, borrowings: [...]}. Never returns error

helpers.name: db_get_user
helpers.returns: Object: {id, username, password, display_name} or None if user doesn't exist
helpers.behaviour: Returns user record for given username, or None if not found

helpers.name: db_get_book
helpers.returns: Object: {id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies} or None if book doesn't exist
helpers.behaviour: Returns book record for given book_id, or None if not found

helpers.name: db_get_borrowing
helpers.returns: Object: {id, user_id, book_id, borrow_date, due_date, status} or None if borrowing doesn't exist
helpers.behaviour: Returns borrowing record for given borrowing_id, or None if not found

helpers.name: db_count_user_active_borrowings
helpers.returns: Number: count of borrowings with status='borrowed' for this user
helpers.behaviour: Counts and returns number of active (status='borrowed') borrowings for the user

helpers.name: db_user_has_borrowed_book
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if user has active borrowing of this book, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Returns true if user has a borrowing record with this book_id and status='borrowed', false otherwise

helpers.name: db_get_all_books
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{id, title, author, isbn, total_copies, available_copies}]
helpers.behaviour: Returns all book records in the database

rules: Users must log in before accessing any feature except the login page
Username and password are both required for login
Book search matches partial title, partial author name, or exact ISBN
Empty search query returns all books
A book is 'Available' if available_copies > 0, otherwise 'Not Available'
Users can borrow up to 5 books simultaneously (borrowing limit)
Users cannot borrow the same book twice while they have an active borrowing of it
Users cannot borrow a book with 0 available copies
Borrowing a book decreases available_copies by 1
Loan period is 14 days from borrow date
Borrow date is always 2024-02-10 (fixed current date)
Due date is always 2024-02-24 (14 days after borrow date)
Returning a book increases available_copies by 1
Returning a book changes its borrowing status from 'borrowed' to 'returned'
Only books with status='borrowed' appear in user's borrowed books list
Users can only return their own borrowed books
SQL injection attempts are treated as invalid credentials
